question: A refrigeration system operates on a vapour compression cycle. If the refrigerant enters the compressor as a saturated vapour at -10°C and leaves the condenser as a saturated liquid at 40°C, what is the primary function of the expansion valve in this cycle?

To reduce the pressure and temperature of the refrigerant, causing partial vaporisation
To superheat the refrigerant vapour before compression
